{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2017}}
{{main|2017 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2017 World Table Tennis Championships women's doubles''' was the 53rd edition of the women's doubles championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Tennis}}</ref><ref name=ITTF>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsWD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120412045730/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsWD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-04-12|title=Women's doubles results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|title=Table Tennis World Championship medal winners|publisher=Sports123}}</ref> [[Liu Shiwen]] and [[Zhu Yuling]] were the defending champions but decided not to play together this year.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.old.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2705&Doubles=1 |title=Entry list |website= |access-date=2017-05-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170512072007/http://www.old.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2705&Doubles=1 |archive-date=2017-05-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

[[Ding Ning]] and Liu defeated [[Chen Meng]] and Zhu 9–11, 11–8, 11–13, 11–8, 11–6, 6–11, 11–9 in the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/2017/06/05/favourites-prevails-japanese-teenager-depart-heads-held-high/|title=Favourites prevail, Japanese teenagers depart heads held high|date=5 June 2017|work=ittf.com}}</ref>

==Seeds==
Matches were best of 5 games in qualification and best of 7 games in the 64-player sized main draw.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.old.ittf.com/World_Events/2017WTTC/Playing_system_WTTC2017.pdf |title=Playing system |access-date=2017-05-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170329113132/http://www.old.ittf.com/World_Events/2017WTTC/Playing_system_WTTC2017.pdf |archive-date=2017-03-29 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[http://d3mjm6zw6cr45s.cloudfront.net/2016/11/2017_WTTC_WD.pdf Seeds]{{Dead link|date=June 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
